notes.name: Komeshcheh Volcano
notes.legend: Erupting volcano. Height: 9567 ft.

notes.name: Somanjiya
notes.legend: A geothermal springs with naturally heated water that provide relaxation and medicinal benefits. Average temperature is 75°F.

notes.name: Paneh Fountain of Youth
notes.legend: This legendary water source is whispered about in ancient tales and believed to possess mystical properties. The spring emanates crystal-clear water, shimmering with an otherworldly iridescence that sparkles even in the dimmest light.

notes.name: Yeongnamho — lead mining town
notes.legend: Yeongnamho is a mining town of 15744 people just nearby the lead mine.

notes.name: Dowsiehriar — salt mining town
notes.legend: Dowsiehriar is a mining town of 13799 people just nearby the salt mine.

notes.name: Taraousa — salt mining town
notes.legend: Taraousa is a mining town of 1502 people just nearby the salt mine.

notes.name: Dedariran — salt mining town
notes.legend: Dedariran is a mining town of 7623 people just nearby the salt mine.

notes.name: Nishikasa Bridge
notes.legend: An old crossing of the Nishikasa River, rarely used since being rumoured to attract trolls.

notes.name: Chengtian Bridge
notes.legend: A weathered bridge spans over the Belbargapur River near Chengtian.

notes.name: The Prime Tavern
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious smoked rat tails with white gin is served here.

notes.name: The Sunny Inn
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside inn. Delicious dry-aged melon with brown juice is served here.

notes.name: The Yellow Spider
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious spit-roasted turkey with fire gin is served here.

notes.name: The White Hawk
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious steamed beef with smoky water is served here.

notes.name: The Grey Cat
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious dry-aged badger with green kvass is served here.

notes.name: Kifuan Lighthouse
notes.legend: A lighthouse to serve as a beacon for ships in the open sea.

notes.name: Iyan Lighthouse
notes.legend: A lighthouse to serve as a beacon for ships in the open sea.

notes.name: Shabadian Waterfall
notes.legend: A breathtaking waterfall cuts through the landscape.

notes.legend: A vast collection of knowledge, including many rare and ancient tomes.

notes.name: Huong Competition
notes.legend: Warriors from around the land gather for a competition of might in Huong, with fame, fortune and favour on offer to the victor.

notes.name: Tsenkhulaan Fair
notes.legend: A fair is being held in Tsenkhulaan, with all manner of local and foreign goods and services on offer.

notes.name: Minor Jetty
notes.legend: A small location along the Tatsushi River to launch boats from sits here, along with a weary looking owner, willing to sell passage along the river.

notes.name: Geese migration
notes.legend: A huge group of geese are migrating, whether part of their annual routine, or something more extraordinary.

notes.name: Almuqaiq gala
notes.legend: A gala has been organised at Almuqaiq as a chance to gather the great and the good of the area together to be merry, make alliances and scheme around the crisis.

notes.name: Illusory mirage
notes.legend: This illusory mirage has been luring travellers out of their way for eons.

notes.name: Jeongdo Cave
notes.legend: The Jeongdo Cave. Locals claim that it is endlessly deep and unexplored.

notes.name: Taita Necropolis
notes.legend: A desolate necropolis where an eerie stillness reigns. Time seems frozen amidst the decaying mausoleums, and the silence is broken only by the whispers of the wind and the rustle of tattered banners.
